svg.title: Map of the Flatiron, NoMad and Union Square office cluster with nearby stores
svg.desc: The cluster runs from 14th to 30th Street between Sixth Avenue and Park Avenue South, plus the blocks around Union Square. 14 stores within about ten blocks are numbered and listed below the map.
svg.text: The office cluster, and natural and specialty food stores within about ten blocks of it.
Grocer with a documented natural, local or emerging set

4 Union Square South · inside the cluster
250 Seventh Avenue · about 3 min walk from the cluster

180 Third Avenue · about 2 min walk from the cluster
275 Third Avenue · about 4 min walk from the cluster
170 West 23rd Street · about 3 min walk from the cluster
550 Second Avenue · about 8 min walk from the cluster
Store list researched on 2026-10-24 from store websites or the New York State retail food store licence list.
A store on this map is not an endorsement, and being on the map does not mean it carries any particular brand.
Walking minutes are from the nearest edge of the cluster at about 73 m a minute. Map is turned so the avenues run up the page.
Streets and parks: NYC Street Centerline (CSCL) and NYC Parks Properties, NYC Open Data.
